# Bright Futures — Spring Cohort

> One of two same-named cohorts. This is the **Spring** cohort (**completed**). Distinct from the
> upcoming [Bright Futures — Fall Cohort](bright-futures-fall.md).

- **Goal / definition of done:** mentor the spring 2026 cohort of **58 seniors** through college
  decisions and enrollment.
- **Owner:** [Andre Willis](../people/andre-willis.md).
- **Status:** **COMPLETED (June 2026).** **88% of the cohort enrolled in college** — a program-best
  result Cam is using in donor updates and the [gala](annual-gala-2026.md) case for support.

## Wrap-up
- Impact stories collected for [Sarah Whitman](../people/sarah-whitman.md)'s quarterly update.
- Lessons feeding the [Fall cohort](bright-futures-fall.md) mentor-matching process.
